title: Bullet-time dash: deterministic time dilation + camera/vignette/streak FX
summary: Every dash now dips the whole simulation clock to 0.35x and eases back (TUNING.bulletTimeScale/bulletRecovery). GameLoop scales one delta for player sim, echo sim, particles and dust so both sims stay in exact lockstep; step.ts dips on dash trigger (next-step onset) and recovers exponentially in sim time. FX: camera FOV punch proportional to the dip, a rose vignette overlay driven per-frame from world.timeScale, and speed-line particles tearing backward while dipped. Reduced-motion skips FOP/vignette/streaks but keeps the slow-mo. Replay storage bumped to v2 (timestamps recorded under the old constant clock mistime on replay). Shots probe now fires a dash and asserts the vignette blooms. Verified: tsc clean, build, checks 49 ok, sim all ok, headless bullet-time screenshot shows vignette + drained cooldown ring.

meta.quality-gate: pass: vignette blooms on dash, lockstep preserved, checks pin dip depth/recovery

title: Adaptive generative soundtrack (Web Audio lookahead scheduler)
summary: New web/lib/music.ts: a procedural chiptune bed sequenced by a 140ms lookahead scheduler over a C-Am-F-G loop (pentatonic-safe against the pickup chimes). The run conducts: tempo 96-132 bpm follows speed, arp/hats gate on an intensity mix of speed+combo, kick on downbeats, combo>=8 adds a sparkle line, hits duck the bed 0.45s, pause/over/mute fade to silence with the sequencer parked to avoid stale-note dumps on resume. Shares the Sfx AudioContext and master bus (new context/output getters); created lazily inside the first gesture; GameLoop conducts it once per frame and ducks on hit events. Shots probe gained a sound pass (click start, pause/resume, assert error-free + progress). Verified: tsc clean, build, checks, sim, full shots run green.

title: Forgiving dash: wider window, shorter cooldown, 0.28s input buffer
summary: Dash timing complaints addressed three ways: invulnerable window 0.22s -> 0.32s (covers a full hazard crossing at top speed), cooldown 1.4s -> 1.2s, and a new input buffer — a press during the cooldown is remembered 0.28s and fires the instant the dash returns (near-miss presses become slightly-early dashes instead of dead inputs). Buffer is sim-state (kitty.dashBufferT) consumed in step.ts via an extracted fireDash helper, so replays and the echo stay deterministic. Sim gained two checks: a press just before cooldown end fires on the dot, and a stale buffer expires without firing. README mechanics + touch bullets updated. Verified: tsc clean, build, checks 49 ok, sim all ok (incl. new buffer checks), full shots suite green.

meta.quality-gate: pass: early presses land, stale presses expire, determinism holds
